title: Document Issue Review
description: Identify name differences, missing records and unresolved queries before resubmitting.
answer: A document problem needs the right question before it needs another submission. We help compare the issue and identify whom to contact; only the responsible issuer can correct its record.

sections.title: Issues we can help you describe
sections.text: Name or father’s-name differences, date discrepancies, missing documents, an unanswered university query or a previous rejection.

sections.title: A practical first review
sections.text: Write down what differs, which record contains it and who raised the query. Avoid including personal numbers or scans in the first message.

sections.title: Corrections belong to issuers
sections.text: Ask the university, identity office or other responsible issuer for the correction or verification procedure. Do not overwrite, erase or digitally alter an official document.

sections.title: No guaranteed resolution
sections.text: A review can clarify next steps, but it does not guarantee correction, acceptance, a successful appeal or an official outcome.

steps: Describe the issue without sensitive files
Ask what evidence the recipient accepts
